jobs.title: Product Owner/Business Analyst (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Product Owner/Business Analyst (m/f/d)

-Bochum-

 

Shape the Future of Mobility with Us!
Trafineo – Your Path to an Innovative Mobility World

As a leading provider of On-Road-Services and mobility solutions in Europe, we combine the strengths of BP Europa SE (Aral) and Circle K (Alimentation Couche-Tard Inc.). Together, we create innovative services – from toll solutions to electromobility – and shape the mobility of tomorrow.

Our Vision: Creating a world where seamless mobility is a reality.
Our Mission: We deliver innovative and value-adding mobility solutions designed for businesses.

Become part of our team and make a difference – for yourself, for us, and for boundless mobility!


In this role, you will combine elements of Business Analysis, Product Ownership, and Project Management to drive the development and continuous improvement of our digital products and services. Acting as a key link between business stakeholders and technical teams, you will analyze requirements, translate them into practical solutions, and coordinate their implementation. With your strong analytical skills and collaborative mindset, you will help ensure our products meet business and customer needs. 

Your Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and translate business and customer requirements into clear specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria

  • Act as a central point of contact between internal departments, external partners, and development teams, ensuring effective communication and alignment

  • Work closely with the Delivery Lead to coordinate product development, manage dependencies, and ensure the successful delivery of new features and improvements

  • Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing business objectives, customer needs, and technical feasibility

  • Configure and adapt product settings and functionalities to meet specific business and customer requirements

  • Support product releases and provide post-launch support, identifying issues, coordinating necessary adjustments, and driving continuous improvements

  • Analyze complex business processes and clarify operational, legal, or tax-related requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders

  • Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to optimize existing products, workflows, and processes

Your Profile

  • Degree in Business Administration, Business Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, or a comparable qualification supported by relevant professional experience

  • Experience in requirements management or business analysis, ideally gained in a product ownership, project management, or comparable role

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex business processes and translate requirements into practical solutions

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge different perspectives and coordinate across teams

  • Collaborative, team-oriented mindset and a structured, solution-focused approach to work

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders

  • Good understanding of IT systems and software development processes, without the need for hands-on technical expertise

  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum or Kanban) and tools such as Jira or Confluence is an advantage

  • Fluent English skills (written and spoken); German skills are a plus

 

Not a perfect match? Apply anyway!

If you bring strong core skills and the motivation to grow, we’re excited to support you.

Why Trafineo? 

  • Security: Join a high-performance team in a rapidly growing market within a future-oriented industry

  • Location & Equipment: Modern office less than five minutes from Bochum main station, equipped with up-to-date workspaces and free on-site parking

  • Attractive Benefits: Enjoy perks such as an Aral Supercard, job bike, fitness subsidy, subsidized lunch, and exclusive discounts through Corporate Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance: 30 days of vacation, 2 additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve, trust-based working hours, and flexible home office options

  • Team & Culture: Be part of an international, collaborative team that values mutual support, open communication, and team spirit

  • Development: Opportunities for professional growth, continuous learning, and taking on new responsibilities in a dynamic environment 

 

Are you ready to actively shape the future of mobility with us? Then apply now – we look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: Principal Consultant* - Project Manager Credit and Capital Management
Senior MarTech Product Manager (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Role summary

You own the marketing-technology layer behind Taxfix's growth: the conversion signals that tell ad networks who converted, the customer data that powers CRM, the consent flows that decide what we may share and with whom, and the referral program, one of the growth mechanics the team owns end to end. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. You set direction for a small engineering team (a tech lead plus 3–4 engineers, two-week sprints) that supports four products across three markets, with Paid Acquisition, CRM, Brand and Creative as internal customers. A typical week mixes debugging a missing ad-network event, scoping a referral reward, settling a data-sharing question with Legal, and explaining trade-offs to leadership. All work, including across markets, happens in English; German is not required.

What you'll do

  • Own conversion-signal engineering for paid acquisition: client-side and server-to-server events into Singular, Firebase/GA4, Google Ads and TikTok, including synthetic events, revenue values and predicted-LTV signals.

  • Run the referral program as a product: reward mechanics, eligibility and fraud rules, voucher infrastructure (Voucherify), the in-app voucher wallet, entry points, and the experiments that tune them.

  • Grow push and marketing-consent opt-in through permission primers, iOS/Android OS permission flows and notification preferences.

  • Keep CRM data trustworthy: Braze attributes and events, Snowflake-to-Braze syncs, event-loss monitoring, and moving legacy messaging (SendGrid, Firebase) onto Braze.

  • Turn consent and privacy requirements into product behaviour, and work with Legal on what data can go to which partner.

  • Adapt tracking, CRM attributes and attribution to company launches, such as new subscription pricing tiers, without breaking downstream campaigns or reporting.

  • Turn stakeholder requests, support escalations and spike findings into tickets engineers can start on, and decide what goes into the sprint.

  • Weigh roadmap work against platform upkeep: pipeline migrations, security fixes, end-of-life SDKs.

  • Design A/B tests (Eppo) and read the results for marketing and consent opt-s, and referral changes.

  • Report progress, risks and trade-offs in writing to marketing leadership, including VP and C-level.

Must-have skills and experience

  • Several years as a product manager owning martech, growth infrastructure or data products, setting your own roadmap with senior stakeholders.

  • Hands-on mobile and web attribution: an MMP (Singular or comparable), server-to-server events, and ad-network conversion setups (Google Ads, TikTok).

  • Event-tracking depth: you can define an event schema, write a tracking spec, and trace a missing or duplicated event through Segment, Google Tag Manager and the receiving platform.

  • CRM data platforms, ideally Braze: custom attributes, event-triggered segmentation, data ingestion and sync quality.

  • Working knowledge of EU consent and privacy: GDPR, consent mode, iOS App Tracking Transparency, and how push permissions behave on iOS and Android.

  • Experimentation: framing hypotheses, choosing and configuring metrics, judging when a result is real.

  • Precise writing: specs that engineers (and AI coding agents) can start on without a meeting, and concise updates and decision memos for leadership.

  • Enough technical fluency to work through trade-offs with engineers across mobile apps (React Native), backend services and data pipelines, and to triage production incidents.

Nice to have

  • Performance marketing experience with the main app and web acquisition channels (e.g. Google Ads, TikTok).

  • Referral, loyalty or voucher programs; Voucherify specifically.

  • Predicted-LTV or value-based bidding signals (e.g. Churney).

  • Deep linking and deferred deep linking across ad networks.

  • AI-driven CRM orchestration (Aampe) or creative asset tooling (Frontify, AI creative tagging).

  • Building AI agents or automation for product and engineering workflows.

  • Querying data yourself in SQL (Snowflake), and familiarity with dbt and Airflow.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Join Apaleo and Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech!

At Apaleo, we're building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d) to help us make Apaleo compliant, fast, wherever we grow next. You'll own the delivery of features that keep our platform compliant across markets, working closely with a Senior Product Management Lead who sets the strategic direction for the wider fiscal and tax domain. 

 

What You'll Be Up To 

  • Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. 
  • Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. 
  • Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. 
  • Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. 
  • Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. 
  • Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. 
  • Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. 
  • Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. 

 

What You'll Bring to the Team 

  • At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. 
  • A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. 
  • Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. 
  • Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. 
  • A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. 
  • Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 

Extra Awesome Points For 

  • Experience with fiscal, tax or legal compliance topics, for example in fintech, e-commerce or ERP systems. This is a genuine nice to have, not a requirement. 
  • Familiarity with platform products where you expose APIs for others to build on. 

 

What We Offer 

  • A diverse, international team. Work alongside passionate people from all sorts of backgrounds, with a genuinely global perspective. 
  • A flat, flexible structure. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. 
  • A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. 
  • Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. 
  • Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. 
  • Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 
  • 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. 
  • Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. 

 

How You'll Make an Impact 

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your work will directly shape how quickly and reliably we can bring our platform to new markets, and the systems you help build will make life easier for every property that runs on Apaleo. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see. 

Apaleo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data is handled with care and in line with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution?  

As the leading SaaS publisher in Europe, Dilitrust is transforming legal departments worldwide with cutting-edge technology.  

Our Impact: From General Meeting reports to AI-assisted contract life management, our teams across France, Spain, Italy, Canada, Mexico, and MEA are the driving force behind our global success. We are pleased to provide daily support to 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of major listed companies in major markets like Europe, North America and the middle East.   

Our Ambition: To be the first French legal tech to achieve Unicorn status, with a valuation surpassing €1 billion.  

Our Recognition: Dilitrust has been recognized for offering a positive and stimulating work environment. We are proud to have been awarded the "Happy at Work" and “Tech at Work” label since 2019.  

 

Your tasks :  

We are currently growing our Product team, adding a Product Manager to consolidate and structure our amazing product. 
 
As Product Manager at Dilitrust, you will report directly to the Chief Product Officer or the Head of Product and work closely with our Developers and Product Designers to design the future of legal software. 

What you will do:  

  • Be the voice of our users – You are passionate about understanding customer needs and believe that talking with users is at the core of a Product Manager’s role. You thrive on identifying key pain points and turning them into impactful product solutions.  

  • Drive meaningful impact – You focus on delivering real value to our customers by solving the right problems, using both qualitative insights and data-driven approaches.  
      

  • Shape the product vision: Advocate for user needs during the definition of new features, ensuring that our product remains aligned with customer expectations and business goals. Become an expert in our business domains to anticipate and analyse market trends.  

  • Collaborate effectively inside and outside your squad: Work hand in hand with developers, product designer and other stakeholders to build the best possible solutions. You facilitate discussions around product impact and ensure incremental delivery of features.  

  • Mesure, observe, iterate: Continuously engage with our users to refine the product, lead discovery discussions, and guide the team in prioritizing the most impactful improvements.  

Profile required:  

Ideally, you have :  

  • Customer-first mindset : You are obsessed with user experience and love talking to customers. You have a strong ability to put yourself in their shoes, understand their challenges, and empathize with their needs.  

  • Iterative mindset : you like to break down a big problem into smaller parts to continuously improve the value of the product  

  • Analytical thinking – You feel comfortable working with data and using it to make informed product decisions.  

  • Collaboration skills – You enjoy working in a team, exchanging ideas, and co-building solutions. You can communicate effectively with other team members and stakeholders to explain and advocate your choices. You can accept a tradeoff when it comes to delivering value to customers.  

  • Growth mindset – You are eager to learn, improve, and take ownership of projects. You want to learn more how legal teams are working.  

  • Language : you are fluent in English, Italian and/or French is a plus  

  • Experience: a first experience in a B2B SaaS is required 

Our values: 

At DiliTrust, our values guide everything we do. Trust is our foundation, ensuring transparency and integrity in every action. 
We promote inclusion, fostering a culture of empathy, diversity and belonging, where everyone's voice is valued.  
We foster a practical spirit, encouraging initiative, resilience and action-oriented thinking to meet challenges.  
We strive for excellence, constantly pushing boundaries to drive innovation, and demonstrating generosity in all our endeavors.  
Above all, we succeed as a team, united by a common goal: collaboration. 

 

What we offer:  

  • Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment (offices in Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Spain, US as well as Dubai);  

  • Our "Telework Charter" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";  

  • Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, lunch vouchers, profitsharing bonuses, etc…  

More info :  

Location: Paris 

Seniority : 2 - 5 years  

Type of contract : Full time, hybrid  

  

DiliTrust is a socially responsible company, committed to the diversity of its teams and to promoting professional equality at all levels.

Principal Consultant* - Business Analyst / Project Manager Payments
Technical Product Lead - AI Stockbroking
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

PRODUCT OWNER

Description

We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order.

 
 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

Unsere Mission

Photovoltaik wirtschaftlich, einfach und sorglos machen. Wir bringen die Energiewende ins Gebäude – mit intelligenten Lösungen für Eigenverbrauch & Elektromobilität, die sich für alle lohnen: Investor:innen, Nutzer:innen und unsere Zukunft.

Als ZEV-Pionierin ist Smart Energy Link heute die führende Schweizer B2B-Plattform für Abrechnung und intelligente Steuerung dezentraler Energieinfrastruktur. Mit einem Team von rund 35 Mitarbeitenden haben wir bereits über 700 Projekte erfolgreich realisiert und betreuen mehr als 20'000 Wohneinheiten im Bereich ZEV und Metering.

Deine Rolle

SEL wächst vom Start-up zum Scale-up – und du gestaltest unsere Produkte in dieser Phase aktiv mit. Als Product Lead verantwortest du unsere Webportale inklusive der Abrechnungslösung und treibst die Produktstrategie gemeinsam mit dem CEO, dem UX-Team und der Entwicklung voran. Du denkst strategisch, führst die Product Discovery und packst bei der Umsetzung mit an – kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheide, echter Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Du verantwortest den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg deiner Produkte, inklusive Preisgestaltung und Markteinführung.

  • Du übersetzt Kunden- und Marktbedürfnisse in eine klare Produkt-Roadmap – im Rahmen der regulatorischen Vorgaben (ZEV/vZEV/LEG).

  • Du entwickelst unsere Webportale zu einer skalierbaren Plattform weiter und verantwortest die Produkt-Vision, -Strategie und -Roadmap.

  • Du sorgst für die marktgerechte Weiterentwicklung der Abrechnungslösung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-SaaS-Plattformen, mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden und in der Skalierung. Technische Konzepte verstehst du so gut, dass du mit der Entwicklung auf Augenhöhe diskutieren kannst.

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in Abrechnungs- und Inkassoprozessen mit, idealerweise in einem ZEV- (vZEV, LEG) Umfeld.

  • Du kennst die Stromtarifmodelle im europäischen Raum und die regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen der Schweiz (Energiewirtschaft).

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und nutzt beide Sprachen im Alltag

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und teamorientiert

  • Du hast eine hohe KI-Affinität.

Schön, aber kein Muss:

Erfahrung mit Elektromobilität oder Smart Grid · Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung interdisziplinärer Teams · technischer Studienabschluss (z. B. Informatik, Elektro-/Energietechnik) oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

Was wir bieten:

Bei SEL arbeitest du an etwas, das zählt: Du prägst die Zukunft des Schweizer Energiesektors mit – Tag für Tag.

  • Bring dich ein und gestalte die Firma aktiv mit - inkl. Mitarbeiterbeteiligung.

  • Wir fördern dein Lernen & Wachstum und beteiligen uns an Kursen, Aus- und Weiterbildungen.

  • Wir leben Flexibilität: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbst

  • Wir arbeiten mit Jahresarbeitszeit und einer 40-Stunden-Woche.

  • plus: NIKIN-Hoodie, Füürabe-Aareschwumm und Glace im Gfrüürfach

Wir sind ein agiles Team, das sich gegenseitig schätzt, fordert und weiterbringt – offen, direkt und auf Augenhöhe. Wenn du Lust hast, wirklich etwas zu bewegen: Werde Energiepionier:in bei SEL.

So geht's weiter

Bewirb dich direkt – wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage bei dir. Unser Prozess: ein kurzes Kennenlerngespräch per Telefon oder Video, ein ausführliches Interview vor Ort oder remote und ein Schnuppertag, an dem du unser Team und unsere Arbeitsweise hautnah erlebst. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Core
jobs.description:
At Channable, we're building the future of eCommerce automation - and at the core of that vision is a world-class engineering organization. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Core Group, where you'll play a key role in integrating eCommerce channels.

🚀 About the role:

As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Core domain, you will lead an engineering department consisting of 3 team leads (your direct reports) who manage ~11 individual contributors.

You’ll be responsible for delivering maximum impact in the Core domain. You will partner up with an experienced Product Lead, with whom you will define and carry out a department vision, strategy, and roadmap. Engaged team leads and individual contributors are top of mind for you. You can learn more about the Core domain and its scope here.

🛠 What you’ll do:

  • Drive the Core roadmap by balancing the overall Channable strategy and the Core's specific opportunities

  • Quantify success by defining and measuring success metrics for the domain as well as team performance

  • Mentor and coach team leads to let them grow and excel at their jobs

  • Drive for high engineering standards by implementing good software development practices and challenging the team to come up with good designs

  • Improve and optimize processes that hamper productivity and can be more lean

  • Build a high-performance culture through fostering accountability, being on top of performance management and focusing on employee engagement

  • You work based on data when you can, and you ensure future decisions take data into account


💡 What we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience as an Engineering Manager leading team leads (preferred) or senior engineers

  • You have demonstrable experience in improving individual and team performance, as well as engagement

  • You have a history of being a software engineer and know how to build high-quality software and the trade-offs that are to be made

  • Outstanding communication skills - you're just as comfortable talking to engineers as you are with stakeholders

  • A mindset focused on pragmatism and growth - you care about setting a high standard for yourself and your team and you continue to reflect to become more productive with minimal technical debt

Some practical things we expect from you:

  • You’re available for at least 32 hours per week

  • You're willing to come to our Utrecht office for two days/week

  • You have a valid work permit, and you're located in the Netherlands

Note: the official job title for this role within Channable is Engineering Manager.

Important note: we understand that studies show women may only apply for roles when they feel they meet 100% of the requirements; therefore, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box, as we are looking for passionate individuals with potential and a willingness to grow.

Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities.
Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

🌟 Why Channable?

At Channable, you’ll find a culture that values openness, craftsmanship, and collaboration. We invest in our people and give them the autonomy to drive meaningful change. You'll work on technical challenges that matter, with colleagues who care deeply about the product and each other.


What do we offer?

  • Gross annual salary ranging from € 100k-120k, including the 8% holiday allowance and based on a 40-hour work week. 

  • Stock Appreciation Rights: You can financially profit from Channable’s success.

  • Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets

  • Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on your professional growth.

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours, with the possibility of buying up to 5 extra vacation days per year

  • Are you going to become a parent? Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • Commuting to our office? Choose between an NS Business Card or a €0.25/km travel allowance for alternative transport. 

  • Work from our office in central Utrecht at least 2 days a week, and from home for the rest (we'll provide the gear and a budget for extra supplies). Plus, enjoy flexible working hours with a morning start window between 8:00 AM and 10:00 AM. 

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!

  • Your well-being matters: we offer a discounted Urban Sports Club subscription and anonymous access to OpenUp psychologists and resources.

  • Fresh daily lunch: enjoy fresh meals prepared Monday to Thursday by our in-house Chef (fully catering to vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free diets). On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads.

  • Additional working conditions include massages, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, an in-office bar, and many more!

  • Channaweek & Channaweekend: connect with your global colleagues at our annual team gathering in Utrecht, and pack your bags for Channaweekend, our annual company-wide getaway. 


How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? To ensure your application reaches the right team quickly, please submit it in English directly through our careers page by clicking the “Apply” button. Applications submitted via email won’t be considered. We look forward to hearing from you as soon as possible!

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, we will get in touch with you for an introduction call (around 25 min)

  2. Then you are going to have a System Design Interview with our team members (1h)

  3. After that, we will schedule a leadership interview (1,5h)

  4. Followed by an on-site meeting to get to know your team (1h)

  5. Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.

Important note: In the current AI era, it's tempting to use technology to polish your interview performance. While we value your ambition, please do not use AI assistance during the screening process, so we can get to know the real person behind the resume.

Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration, and we believe in a diverse and inclusive team

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
jobs.description:
Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine

About Us

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.

Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up.

You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery.

If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base.

  • Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent.

  • Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance.

  • Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

  • Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results.

  • Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

  • Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.

  • Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact.

  • Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.

  • Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Driven measurable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit — moving business metrics, not just quality metrics.

  • Driven measurable business-metric lift (conversion, revenue per visit, GMV) and relevance lift across every major retail vertical we serve.

  • Shipped at least one state-of-the-art ML / LLM-assisted capability into production that beats our previous best on relevance.

  • Won head-to-head quality benchmarks against every major competitor in the verticals we compete in, with a repeatable, defensible methodology.

  • Taken core quality metrics to best-in-class levels and kept them improving quarter over quarter.

  • Stood up an evaluation framework and tooling that ties model and system investments directly to customer business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in search, discovery, ML, or NLP-heavy products, including time operating at a senior or staff level.

  • A track record of moving business metrics at scale — conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams.

  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end search pipeline: query interpretation → recall / candidate generation → ranking → reranking → personalization → delivery.

  • Strong ML product depth — owning production models and reasoning about tradeoffs between high-capacity (LLM / batch) and low-latency (real-time) approaches — and a habit of staying current with state-of-the-art research.

  • Fluency with retrieval and recall, query understanding (tokenization, synonyms, spelling correction, multilingual support), and search evaluation frameworks.

  • A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every quality investment back to business outcomes.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of quality and a shared set of business metrics, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and ML Ops.

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart.

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options.

  • Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee).

  • Fully remote team — choose where you live.

  • Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office.

  • Apple laptops provided for new employees.

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

  • Parental leave for qualified employees.

  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

This position is fully remote — Constructor.io is a remote-first company.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

How we handle your data. By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Avionics, GNC & Flight Software
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Avionics, Guidance, Navigation and Control (GNC), and Flight Software (FSW) functions are central to the safe and reliable operation of the vehicle. Together, they provide the electronic systems, control capabilities and software that guide Nyx through its mission - from launch and on-orbit operations to docking, re-entry and recovery.

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Project Manager — Avionics, GNC & Flight Software to coordinate the development and delivery of these critical domains within the Nyx program.

Your Mission

As Project Manager for Avionics, GNC and Flight Software, you will be responsible for coordinating the execution of these work packages and ensuring that their development remains aligned with the overall Nyx program objectives.

You will work closely with Avionics, GNC and FSW technical leads, systems engineering, propulsion, mission operations, verification and integration teams. Your role will be to create transparency on scope, schedule, interfaces, risks and decisions, while supporting the teams in delivering robust and well-verified capabilities for the vehicle.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who enjoys working at the interface between technical teams, program management and mission execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and coordinate the project planning for the Avionics, GNC and FSW work packages within the Nyx program.

  • Translate program objectives and major milestones into clear plans, priorities and deliverables for the relevant teams.

  • Coordinate the development lifecycle from requirements definition and architecture through implementation, integration, verification and release across Avionics, GNC and FSW.

  • Maintain visibility of scope, schedule, dependencies, risks, opportunities and resource needs across the Avionics, GNC and FSW activities.

  • Coordinate closely with the Avionics, GNC and FSW technical leads to monitor progress, identify blockers and support timely decisions.

  • Ensure that technical, program and interface dependencies between Avionics, GNC, FSW, systems engineering, propulsion and mission operations are identified and actively managed.

  • Support the planning and execution of avionics integration, software and hardware-in-the-loop activities, simulations, system integration and mission rehearsals.

  • Coordinate inputs to design reviews, development reviews, qualification activities and other program milestones.

  • Track the preparation and closure of requirements, verification activities, test results, documentation and technical actions.

  • Identify schedule and delivery risks early, define mitigation actions with the relevant owners and escalate unresolved issues when required.

  • Support the management of changes to scope, requirements, interfaces and priorities, ensuring that their impacts are understood.

  • Prepare clear progress updates, decision material and status reports for program and project reviews.

  • Facilitate regular coordination meetings and ensure that actions, decisions and commitments are recorded and followed through.

  • Contribute to resource and capacity planning for the GNC and FSW activities.

  • Support coordination with external partners, suppliers and customers when relevant to the project scope.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of project-management processes, planning practices and reporting routines within the Nyx program.

What You Bring

  • Experience in project or program management within aerospace, space systems, aviation, automotive, robotics, embedded systems or another safety and reliability critical environment.

  • A good understanding of spacecraft avionics, GNC, flight software, embedded software or closely related technical domains.

  • Experience coordinating complex technical work packages involving multiple teams and interfaces.

  • Practical experience managing plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, actions and technical deliverables.

  • The ability to understand technical topics sufficiently to ask the right questions, identify impacts and support informed decisions.

  • Experience working across requirements, design, implementation, integration, testing and verification activities.

  • Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to bring structure and transparency to complex projects.

  • A proactive approach to identifying risks, raising issues early and driving actions to closure.

  • The ability to work effectively with technical experts while maintaining focus on program objectives and delivery commitments.

  • Experience with project-management, planning, requirements-management or engineering tools.

  • A degree or equivalent experience in aerospace engineering, software engineering, systems engineering, project management or a related field.

  • Professional fluency in English. Additional European languages are a plus.

What Makes You Special

You are technically curious and comfortable working with experts in avionics, GNC, flight software and other disciplines. You can move between detailed technical discussions and program-level decision-making without losing sight of the overall objective.

You bring structure without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. You are proactive in identifying dependencies and risks, clear in your communication and persistent in following actions through to closure. You know how to challenge constructively, support technical teams and escalate decisions when the program needs clarity.

You are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to a complex space vehicle and understand that reliable GNC and flight software are built through close collaboration, disciplined engineering and continuous verification.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

jobs.title: Partner Delivery Manager | Remote | Europe
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to build and scale a high-performing partner delivery program that enables n8n to deliver exceptional customer outcomes through trusted services partners. You'll ensure partner-led engagements are seamlessly coordinated, commercially sound, and consistently high-quality, helping us scale our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) capabilities without compromising on customer experience.

Responsibilities:

Build and Scale Partner Delivery Operations

  • Define and continuously improve the delivery playbooks, engagement processes, and quality standards that underpin partner-led FDE engagements.

  • Own engagement intake and allocation, coordinating with internal FDE teams and Partnerships to determine the right delivery model and partner for each customer.

  • Provide visibility into program performance, capacity, delivery risks, and key learnings to Customer Success, Partnerships, and Sales leadership.

Own Partner Commercials and Governance

  • Manage partner subcontracting agreements, statements of work (SOWs), and rate cards in collaboration with Legal, Finance, and Procurement.

  • Oversee partner billing, engagement costs, and commercial structures across different delivery models, ensuring accurate financial tracking.

  • Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations to ensure engagements are structured and reported correctly, including their impact on ARR and compensation.

Drive Partner Performance and Readiness

  • Define and track partner KPIs and SLAs, including staffing speed, delivery quality, customer satisfaction, utilization, and adoption outcomes.

  • Run partner performance reviews, maintain scorecards, and drive corrective actions to continuously improve delivery standards.

  • Maintain visibility into partner capacity and certified consultants across regions, while coordinating onboarding, certification, access, and offboarding with Enablement and Partner Solution Engineering.

Ensure Outstanding Customer Outcomes

  • Ensure every partner-led engagement has a clear scope, measurable success criteria, and a smooth handoff to the Customer Success Manager.

  • Proactively identify, escalate, and resolve delivery risks before they impact customer relationships or project outcomes.

  • Capture and share learnings from workshops, hackathons, and staff augmentation engagements to continuously refine and scale the delivery model.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 🤝 Partner Delivery Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in partner delivery, professional services operations, or vendor/subcontractor management within a software or technology company.

  • 📝 Commercial & Contract Management: You're experienced in drafting, negotiating, and managing SOWs, subcontracting agreements, and commercial frameworks with services partners or systems integrators.

  • 📊 Performance & Governance: You know how to build meaningful KPIs and SLAs, establish partner governance processes, and use performance data to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

  • 🔗 Cross-functional Collaboration: You're confident navigating competing priorities and working effectively with Legal, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams.

  • ⚙️ Operational Excellence: You're highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple partner engagements, timelines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • 🚀 Builder Mindset: You thrive in fast-moving environments where processes are still evolving, and you're excited to build scalable systems while keeping day-to-day operations running smoothly.

Nice-to-have

  • 🌍 Global Partner Ecosystems: You have experience working with global systems integrators or large professional services organizations.

  • 💼 Services Delivery Models: You're familiar with staff augmentation, partner-led workshops, hackathons, or other technical services delivery models.

  • 🛠️ Technical Understanding: You have a background in workflow automation, systems integration, low-code platforms, or related technologies.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build a critical part of how we scale customer delivery. Rather than simply managing an established partner program, you'll shape the processes, commercial frameworks, and performance standards that enable our partners to deliver outstanding customer outcomes around the world.

You'll work closely with leaders across Customer Success, Partnerships, Sales, and Finance, giving you meaningful visibility and influence as we scale our Forward Deployed Engineering capabilities. You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, where autonomy, experimentation, and a builder mindset are part of how we work.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

jobs.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.

In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.

As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.

For Cruise Liners, you will develop itinerary intelligence for tracked fleets, providing an independent view of actual sailed itineraries, fuel consumption and emissions. For Port Operations, you will build a product focused on port-level vessel activity monitoring, giving port authorities a reliable, live view of activity and performance.

This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in maritime, cruise, travel, ports or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. You will need to balance competing priorities across two products, establish trusted data methodologies, engage customers and bring both products to market through a pragmatic, build-and-iterate approach.

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Cruise Liners and Port Operations, prioritising customer needs and commercial opportunities while making trade-offs between the two products explicit.
  • Lead market discovery with cruise operators, port authorities, harbour masters and terminal operators, gathering requirements and translating customer needs into product priorities.
  • Drive delivery across both products, maintaining clear roadmaps, delivery cadences and launch plans, with a pragmatic approach focused on launching initial capabilities and iterating based on feedback.
  • Establish trusted data and benchmarking methodologies for both products, developing an independent view of cruise itineraries, fuel and emissions, alongside consistent port call-cycle measurement and performance benchmarking.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Sales, Product Marketing and other product teams to align delivery, reuse shared data and emissions capabilities, and develop early data and distribution partnerships.
  • Define the Cruise Liners product direction, delivering fleet itinerary intelligence based on live, observed vessel movements that reflects actual sailed journeys rather than published schedules.

  • Develop product positioning and competitive strategy, identifying opportunities to differentiate Kpler’s independent, first-party observed data from existing cruise analytics and port operations offerings.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to take on the hardest problems in the data and integration platform that everything at Nelly runs on: how practice data gets into Nelly from dozens of practice management systems, how partners connect to us, and how that data becomes something every product can depend on. At Staff level, your scope follows the problem, across teams and over time into product-wide questions.

The problem space: Every Nelly product, from documentation to billing to payments, depends on data that lives in a practice's management system. There are dozens of them, each with its own data model and interfaces.

How many practices we can serve, how much of their work we can automate, and how much they trust the result come down to four questions: can we connect, can we read and write deeply enough, is the data any good once it arrives, and can every product and team inside Nelly easily build on it?

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Own the strategy, metrics and roadmap for hard data and integration problems, from how data leaves a practice's system, through ingestion and modelling, to the products that rely on it, tied to real practice value and to how Nelly makes money

  • Shape how partners connect to Nelly through our External API, so we can serve practices on any system and open new markets beyond Germany

  • Define the core data every product relies on: what a patient, an appointment, a treatment plan or an invoice means, who owns it, and how fresh and reliable it is, with GDPR and health-data regulation built in from the start

  • Make data and integration quality measurable and visible, and move it, because practices feel a silent failure long before we do

  • Hold an end-to-end model of the platform and be a credible partner to engineering on architecture and trade-offs

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer - Portfolio Data Workflows
Team Lead Data Science & Machine Learning (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. Our Data Science & Machine Learning team in Pre-Development owns the chain from raw quantum sensor data to the current map an engineer can act on: the statistical evaluation of the sensor signal, the simulation and training data pipelines, the reconstruction of fields and currents, with the machine learning pipeline for three-dimensional current in production today, and the validation of every map against simulation and reference measurements. The machine learning here is physics-based: supervised models on measurement data, inverse problems, image reconstruction. It is not a generative AI role.

We are looking for a Team Lead to take over this team of currently eight data scientists and machine learning engineers plus interns, with a clear growth perspective, from our Head of Pre-Development, who has led it directly until now. You lead the people, own the backlog as product owner in our Scrum setup, and are accountable for a production ML pipeline that chipmakers rely on, with protected time for the research that becomes the next generation of the QDm. You work alongside two peer team leads in Pre-Development.

This is a leadership role with a strong technical spine, not a principal engineer role with a few reports.

 

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

  • Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

  • Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

  • Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

  • An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

  • You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

  • From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

  • Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

  • You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

 
 

What will you do

  • Lead and grow the team: hire, develop and keep its data scientists and ML engineers delivering together.

  • Own the backlog as product owner in our Scrum setup: prioritize production reliability against research, aligned with Applications and the two other product owners in Pre-Development and the company roadmap.

  • Own the production ML pipeline for 3D current reconstruction end to end, from training data to release, and set the engineering standards it needs: CI/CD, reproducibility, testing, and how the team uses AI coding agents.

  • Own the data science side as well: the evaluation that turns raw sensor data into field maps, the validation that says whether a map can be trusted, the FEM simulations behind the models, and the measurement algorithms for the next platform generation.

  • Pathfind our data strategy with the Head of Pre-Development, who owns it: how measurement sessions, labels and failure-analysis knowledge get captured and used.

 

What is expected of you

  • 8+ years of professional experience in data science or machine learning outside academia, at least 3 of them leading a technical team with people responsibility.

  • A senior or principal-level technical track record before leadership: you still read code and can tell a sound model validation from a flattering one.

  • Product owner experience in Scrum or a comparable framework.

  • You have shipped models trained on physical measurement data (sensors, cameras, detectors) into production.

  • Fluency in Python and the modern ML stack (PyTorch or comparable), and working knowledge of MLOps practice: CI/CD, versioning, validation, and release.

  • Fluent English; German is an advantage, not a requirement. On-site in Munich.

You do not need a background in quantum sensing or semiconductors; we will build that with you. What we cannot teach on the job is leading strong technical people, product-owner judgement, and the discipline that turns research code into a product, and that is exactly what we want you to bring.

 

Our benefits

  • Mission: At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products - we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual.

  • Impact & growth: This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast.

  • Health & fitness: With a company-sponsored Wellpass membership, you’ll have access to countless gyms, classes, and wellness offers across Germany to stay healthy and active.

  • Team & culture: We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment.

  • Well-being & balance: We value rest and recovery. That’s why you’ll enjoy 30 vacation days plus public holidays to recharge and return inspired.

  • Learning & development: Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills.

  • Ownership & participation: As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together.

 

About us

QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.
