jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - SaaS
jobs.description:
About Dastra

Dastra is a fast-growing SaaS platform dedicated to data protection, compliance and AI governance.

Our mission is simple: turn complex regulatory requirements into clear, operational and actionable processes.

We help organisations manage their data and AI-related risks while enabling them to innovate with confidence.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success team and support our customers throughout their journey with Dastra.

Why join Dastra?

  • Join a fast-growing European SaaS LegalTech company

  • Work with Mid-Market and Enterprise organisations on complex data, AI and compliance challenges

  • Take ownership of a strategic customer portfolio

  • Become a key expert on a sophisticated SaaS platform

  • Work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product and Tech teams

  • Join an experienced, collaborative and ambitious team

Your role

As a Customer Success Manager, you will act as the project lead for your customers’ success with Dastra.

You will manage a portfolio of Mid-Market and Enterprise customers and cover the entire customer journey, with a strong focus on onboarding, implementation, product adoption and long-term customer success.

You will become a trusted partner and expert on the Dastra platform, helping customers translate complex business, technical and regulatory challenges into concrete use cases.

Your main objectives will be to:

  • Successfully onboard and implement Dastra

  • Drive product adoption and long-term engagement

  • Support change management

  • Demonstrate the value delivered by the platform

  • Secure renewals and customer satisfaction

  • Identify growth opportunities alongside Account Managers

Your responsibilities

  • Lead onboarding and implementation projects

  • Manage a portfolio of Mid-Market and Enterprise customers as their main point of contact

  • Drive customer success through regular follow-ups and Business Reviews

  • Monitor usage, satisfaction and value

  • Anticipate risks and secure renewals

  • Identify growth opportunities alongside Account Managers

  • Build expertise in data protection, AI governance and compliance

  • Share customer insights with Product and Tech teams

Your environment

You will join our Customer Success team and report to Jérôme, our Director of Operations and co-founder.

You will work closely with our Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, Product and Tech teams.

Our customers are mainly Mid-Market and Enterprise organisations, across French and international markets.

During your first 3 to 6 months, you will progressively build your expertise on Dastra, our methodology and your customer portfolio.

Who we're looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, SaaS consulting, implementation, project management or a similar customer-facing role

  • Strong understanding of SaaS environments, ideally involving complex or technical products

  • Experience managing Mid-Market and/or Enterprise customers

  • Experience with onboarding, implementation, adoption and change management

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Strong project management and organisational skills

  • Customer-oriented, autonomous and comfortable with complex topics

Languages

  • French: fluent, bilingual

  • English: fluent, bilingual or native level

  • German: fluent or bilingual proficiency would be a plus

You will work with both French- and English-speaking customers in an international environment.

Compensation & working conditions

  • Around €40-47k gross/year + variable compensation, depending on experience

  • Ideally based in Paris / Île-de-France

  • Hybrid working model with 2 remote days per week

  • 5 weeks of paid leave + 10 RTT days

  • Meal vouchers and company health insurance

  • Annual company seminar and regular team-building events

Recruitment process

  1. Introductory call with Julia, Talent Acquisition Specialist

  2. Interview with a member of the Customer Success team

  3. Interview with Jérôme, Director of Operations and co-founder

  4. Business case and presentation

  5. Reference check

Ready to join us?

If you enjoy working at the intersection of SaaS, technology, data, AI and regulatory challenges, and want to become a trusted partner for Mid-Market and Enterprise customers, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist
jobs.description:
Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in railway and industrial electrification systems, offering cutting-edge solutions to enhance transportation and decarbonize industrial processes. With a rich heritage of over a century and a commitment to innovation, Sécheron Hasler Group is growing worldwide.

For the Electrical Safety Solutions (ESS) Business Unit, we are looking for an experienced marketing professional with a strong interest in technical products and industrial markets. The Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist will translate ESS business priorities and product value propositions into clear marketing communications, sales tools, product training and customer-facing materials. The candidate will work closely with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers, Sales and the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.

Global objectives:

  • Drive the execution of the ESS marketing plan and business growth priorities, in cooperation with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers and Sales.
  • Develop and maintain marketing and sales materials for existing and new products and applications.
  • Develop product marketing communication using various communication channels to promote ESS and its respective products.
  • Work with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team for trade shows/fairs and manage the required preparation and coordination with the respective Business Unit teams.
  • Provide marketing inputs and product communication materials to support Product Line Managers and Sales.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver marketing communication plans based on ESS business priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager.
  • Contribute to product launch plans defined with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers; coordinate the preparation and delivery of marketing materials, training and communication activities
  • Develop marketing and sales materials, including commercial brochures, PowerPoint presentations, promotional videos and animations for products and applications, and website content.
  • Collect and structure market and competitor information; prepare customer-oriented product messages, competitive comparisons and sales enablement materials in collaboration with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers.
  • Develop product training materials with Product Line Managers and support training for the worldwide Sales network.
  • Maintain product documentation for intranet and corporate purposes.
  • Coordinate annual exhibition and trade show preparation within ESS, based on priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager and Sales, and in alignment with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.
  • Develop marketing concepts, communication campaigns, exhibition experiences, templates and customer engagement initiatives aligned with ESS business priorities.
  • Contribute to the annual ESS strategy review by preparing marketing performance indicators, communication plans and supporting materials.
  • Support the continuous improvement of ESS sales enablement tools and materials, helping ensure that Sales teams have up-to-date product messaging, training and communication.

Requirements

  • Further education in industrial product marketing
  • Degree in marketing, communications, business or a technical field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
  • Ability to understand electronic products and translate technical information into clear customer-facing content.
  • Solid experience in marketing communications, product marketing or sales enablement in an international industrial B2B environment.
  • Experience creating marketing materials for technical products and collaborating with Sales, Product Management or Engineering teams.
  • Experience coordinating projects and stakeholders across different countries or functions.
  • Experience in product marketing, marketing communications or sales enablement for technical products.
  • Good knowledge of at least one of the following industry sectors: high voltage, railway traction systems, power transmission & distribution, renewable energy and e-mobility.
  • Interest and ability to understand DC and AC power systems and corresponding product needs.
  • Excellent project management, organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate technical information into clear marketing messages and customer benefits.
  • Proven ability to think creatively, identify and resolve problems.
  • Experienced to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in MS-Office programs.

Benefits

We foster flat hierarchies and direct communication, enabling quick decisions and strong collaboration across all levels. You’ll be trusted with real responsibility and encouraged to take initiative, with plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Senior Implementatie Consultant SaaS, €4.250 – €6.000 | Breda
jobs.description:
Wil jij als Senior Implementatie Consultant meer end to end verantwoordelijkheden krijgen? Bij Whitevision geven we je meer autonomie en ruimte om processen bij de klant en binnen het team te verbeteren. Kortom, wil je meer strategisch adviseren, collega’s coachen en écht impact maken binnen een snelgroeiende internationale SaaS-organisatie? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je.

Jouw rol
Als Senior Implementatie Consultant word je verantwoordelijk voor meerdere implementaties bij verschillende organisaties, met een diversiteit aan Whitevision producten. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt en de trusted advisor voor jouw klanten. Je bepaalt grotendeels zelf, in overleg met de klant, waar je je werkzaamheden uitvoert. Je analyseert klantprocessen, denkt strategisch mee over de beste inrichting en begeleidt organisaties servicegericht naar een succesvolle livegang.

Je werkt zelfstandig, deelt je kennis met het team en coacht startende consultants. Je signaleert commerciële kansen bij bestaande klanten en draagt bij aan standaardisatie en verbetering van onze consultancyprocessen, die het team als geheel beter maken bijvoorbeeld door het inzetten van AI gedreven functionaliteit. Tegelijk blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen: je vergroot je productkennis, houdt je vakkennis bij en krijgt de ruimte om door te groeien richting een leidinggevende, coachende of expertrol binnen onze consultancyorganisatie. Je taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn:
+ Je leidt end to end de implementatietrajecten.
+ Je analyseert documentprocessen en vertaalt deze naar slimme, schaalbare oplossingen.
+ Je adviseert klanten op operationeel én managementniveau.
+ Je traint eindgebruikers en zorgt voor maximale adoptie van onze software.
+ Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid binnen je projecten.
+ Je coacht junior en medior consultants en deelt actief je kennis.


Wat breng je mee?
+ Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde Hbo, bijvoorbeeld richting BIM, Bedrijfskunde of bedrijfseconomie.
+ Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren van software-implementaties.
+ Je hebt al ervaring met projectleiding en stakeholdermanagement.
+ Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden (Nederlands én Engels).
+ Analytisch, resultaatgericht en commercieel bewust.
+ Ervaring met SaaS-oplossingen, SQL, ERP en affiniteit met documentverwerking is een pré.
+ Een coachende instelling: je vindt het leuk om collega’s verder te helpen.
+ Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar (onze voorkeur gaat uit naar 40 uur).


Jij bent de consultant waar klanten om vragen en waar collega’s van leren.
Bij Whitevision krijg je de ruimte, het vertrouwen en de schaal van een groeiende Europese groep om écht impact te maken.


Wat bieden wij?
Naast het werken binnen een gezellig, gemotiveerd en betrokken team bieden wij jou:
+ Een salaris tussen €4.250 en €6.000 (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van je opleiding en ervaring.
+ Een auto van de zaak, laptop, mobiele telefoon en pensioenregeling.
+ 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur).
+ Een inspirerende werkomgeving met flexibiliteit in locatie/werkplek (hybride) en werktijden.
+ Verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid in je rol, met invloed op onze diensten en strategie.
+ Een professioneel en hardwerkend team,  waar samenwerken en ontspanning samen gaan.
+ Een informele organisatie waar we regelmatig uitjes organiseren met het team en bedrijf

Over Whitevision
Whitevision is een toonaangevende SaaS-speler in Intelligent Document Processing & Management, die meer dan 2300 organisaties helpt hun documentprocessen slimmer, sneller en betrouwbaarder te maken. Wij ontwikkelen slimme, schaalbare en betrouwbare tools voor factuurverwerking, procurement, spend en document management, die naadloos integreren met een breed scala aan ERP-systemen.

Vandaag de dag vertrouwen onze klanten op onze oplossingen. Vanuit kantoren in Breda, Rotterdam, Zoetermeer, De Goorn, Milton Keynes en Southampton werken ruim 140 medewerkers aan de doorontwikkeling en toepassing ervan, in een cultuur gebouwd op de kernwaarden betrokken, ambitieus, respectvol en daadkrachtig.

Als Senior Implementatie Consultant speel je een sleutelrol: jij zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten succesvol live gaan én tevreden blijven. Je werkt nauw samen met 45 gedreven collega’s in het Support & Consultancy team. In een omgeving waar je je productkennis verder verdiept en je expertise volop kunt inzetten en uitbouwen.

Doorgroeimogelijkheden

Binnen Whitevision krijg je de ruimte om door te groeien naar rollen met meer strategische, organisatorische en internationale impact. Afhankelijk van jouw ambities kun je je ontwikkelen richting meer inhoudelijke diepgang (solution expert) of juist breder leiderschap als Lead of Manager binnen onze snelgroeiende internationale organisatie.

Standplaats
Zoetermeer of Breda

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Management - Benelux
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Dutch-speaking, customer-oriented and results-driven candidate to join our Benelux & Nordics Account Management team. As an Enterprise Account Manager at Perk, you will be actively contributing to our continued customer satisfaction as well as working to increase growth and margin within existing accounts. In this role you will be responsible for a portfolio of top accounts. You must possess a genuine hunger to navigate your accounts in a fast-changing, hyper-growth environment, be ready to roll-up your sleeves and work hard.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of Tier 1 Customers and develop a high level of customer engagement with your contact and key decision makers within your accounts

  • Gain a deep understanding of your customers business and be able to leverage this information to ensure that the customer maximises their usage of Perk

  • Identify growth opportunities and develop your portfolio by adding new business opportunities

  • Leverage data analytics to provide clients with regular business reviews, reports and presentations to senior stakeholders

  • Be an expert on the portfolio of Perk products in order to meet & exceed quarterly targets of Up / Cross-selling

  • Develop strong relationships with your clients that will shape their business travel programmes

  • Identify common problems within each account and develop strategies to solve issues in a timely manner whilst creating methods to ensure long term solutions

  • Act as a key contact between the internal Perk teams and the Account Management Team, to ensure product integrations during roll-outs are as smooth as possible.

  • Effectively prioritise your time in order to maximise impact in key business areas

What we’re looking for

  • Native Dutch and professional proficiency in English

  • Experience managing top tier accounts

  • Outstanding presentation & communication skills and the ability to build deep relationships

  • Great prioritisation and time management skills

  • Result oriented mindset while keeping customer satisfaction as your top priority

  • Great ability to analyse and translate data for your customers

On top of that, you will be the right candidate if you are

  • Empathetic: someone who can identify with the customer and genuinely wants to support them using an optimal problem-solving methodology

  • Honest, open and trustworthy: your peers and managers can trust you. You are a team player, don’t play political games, and care more about the team’s success than about your own career gains

jobs.title: Product Manager, Interactive Avatars (Staff/Principal-level)
jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back.

We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there.

It's early. Interactive Avatars is in closed beta today, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on.

This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta.

 

The problem you're solving

Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build.

We have the avatar technology and a working beta. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles

  • Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them

  • Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves

  • Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time

  • Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job

  • Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business

Who you are

You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly.

You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes.

You care about the detail, and you can hold a quality bar for something subjective and hard: a real-time avatar either feels present and responsive or it feels off, and the difference lives in latency, interruption handling, expressiveness, and consistency. You know how to make that bar concrete and defend it.

You think commercially. A new API isn't just a technical surface. It's a business, and you have instincts (or scar tissue) around how developer products get adopted, packaged, and monetized.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in product, with direct experience owning a developer-facing API, SDK, or platform product. The vertical doesn't matter, the platform depth does

  • Comfortable operating in an early-stage, 0→1 environment where discovery and delivery happen in parallel and the roadmap is still being shaped

  • Strong technical fluency: you can hold a credible conversation with engineers about real-time systems, latency, and integration trade-offs, and make good calls without needing every answer handed to you

  • Strong written communication: you can write a spec, a strategy doc, or an API design rationale that others can act on without a follow-up conversation

  • Real-time / streaming media, conversational AI, or applied-AI product experience is a strong plus but not a prerequisite.

  • Instinct for the commercial side of a developer product - adoption, packaging, and monetization is a plus.

  • Based in London or open to regular in-person time.

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Location

Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

 

Global benefits:

  • You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity.

  • You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

  • Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person.

  • Work from home budget

  • Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

  • Generous referral scheme

  • Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater—our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)

Benefits specific to UK:

  • 5% pension match

  • Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office

  • Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

Met vestigingen en activiteiten in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Nederland, België, Frankrijk, de DACH-regio en Oost-Europa zijn wij een werkelijk internationale organisatie. Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv, inclusief een motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft:

1. Je praktische technische ervaring met PaperCut of andere producten binnen het ITS-portfolio, inclusief de omgevingen waarin je deze hebt geïmplementeerd, ondersteund of beheerd.

3. Je taalvaardigheden en, indien van toepassing, je kennis van de clusterregio en het bijbehorende partnernetwerk.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
Growth Marketing Lead (f/m/d)

Deine Rolle

Als Growth Marketing Lead (f/m/d) bist du der operative Taktgeber unserer Wachstumsmaschine: Du implementierst, steuerst und optimierst unsere wachstumsorientierten Marketingmaßnahmen kanalübergreifend und arbeitest Marketing-Roadmap und Kampagnenstrategie gemeinsam mit unseren Growth Managern aus. Du führst das Performance Marketing Team und verantwortest Budgets, Kanalstrategie sowie unser CRM- und Lifecycle-Marketing. Dein Verantwortungsbereich ist bewusst breit angelegt: Neben Performance und CRM gehören Partnerschaften und externe Dienstleister dazu, perspektivisch können weitere Marketingthemen wie Events hinzukommen. Aus Erfahrung weißt du genau, wie Performance Marketing wirklich funktioniert, und hinterfragst und steuerst interne Teams, Agenturen und Partner auf Augenhöhe.

Was machst du konkret?

Growth Marketing & Kanalsteuerung

  • Du verantwortest CAC, Payback-Periode und den Umsatzbeitrag des Marketings, steuerst Kanäle und Kampagnen gegen diese Zielgrößen und speist deine laufende Bewertung von Kohorten und Retention als Kundenqualität in die Akquisitionsentscheidung zurück.

  • Du bist fachlicher Lead für alle Paid Channels (u.a. Google, Meta, LinkedIn) und hast Budgethoheit in deinen Kanälen: Du setzt Kampagnenstrukturen eigenständig auf, challengst und optimierst sie, verantwortest das Pacing gegen unsere Ziele und planst den Spend belastbar.

  • Du verantwortest die Kampagnen-Infrastruktur rund um unsere Paid-Aktivitäten — E-Mail-Sequenzen, Nurturing-Strecken und conversion-optimierte Landing Pages — und stimmst dich dafür eng mit Content und Product über Aufbau, Inhalte, CRO und Kampagnen-Koordination ab.

  • Du verantwortest die Growth Marketing Roadmap und entwickelst Kampagnenstrategien gemeinsam mit unseren Growth Managern, für die du fachlicher Sparringspartner bist — dabei hast du stets neue Wachstumskanäle im Blick.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Product Team, um unsere organischen Platzierungen (SEO, AEO) konstant zu überwachen und zu verbessern.

  • Du verantwortest CRM und Lifecycle Marketing end-to-end (insb. HubSpot): Segmentierung, Automationen und Kampagnen entlang des Kundenlebenszyklus, gemessen an Aktivierung, Conversion und Wiederkauf. Du gestaltest diesen Bereich selbst, statt ihn nur als Schnittstelle zu begleiten.

  • Du verantwortest Qualifizierung und Scoring der Leads gegen unser Zielkundenprofil, steuerst Routing und Übergabe und stimmst Lead-Volumen und Betreuungskapazität laufend ab.

Team & Zusammenarbeit

  • Du führst ein Team aus Performance Marketing Managern und CRM Managern, entwickelst es fachlich weiter und lässt den Verantwortungsbereich mit dem Team mitwachsen.

  • Du steuerst Agenturen, Partner und externe Dienstleister eigenständig — von Auswahl und Vergütungsmodell über Briefing und Qualitätssicherung bis zur laufenden Leistungsbewertung.

  • Perspektivisch können weitere Marketingthemen wie Events in deine Verantwortung wachsen — Vorerfahrung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du steuerst den Freigabeprozess für Werbemittel und Kundenkommunikation gemeinsam mit Compliance und stellst die geforderte Dokumentation sicher — ein fester Schritt in jeder Kampagnenplanung.

  • Du entwickelst unser Creative Operating Model weiter: eine kontinuierliche Testpipeline über alle Formate, gesteuert über Hit Rate und creative-getriebene Effizienz, in enger Taktung mit der Content-Produktion — und sicherst gemeinsam mit Brand und Content die Konsistenz von Botschaft und Auftritt zwischen Performance-Kampagnen und Markenauftritt.

Strategie & Reporting

  • Du bringst dich aktiv in die Wachstumsstrategie des Marketing-Teams ein — als jemand, der nicht nur denkt, sondern auch umsetzt: Du erschließt neue Kanäle und inhaltliche Skalierungspotenziale, entwickelst Affiliate-, Partner- und Empfehlungskanäle als eigenständigen Wachstumshebel und hältst relevante Prozesse in Playbooks fest.

  • Du verantwortest Messarchitektur und Reporting end-to-end: serverseitiges Tracking, Attributionsmodelle über alle Kanäle und KPI-Transparenz über alle Kampagnen, damit das gesamte Team fundierte Entscheidungen treffen kann — unterstützt durch KI-gestützte Workflows, die Produktion, Analyse und Reporting automatisieren.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing oder Growth Marketing, idealerweise in einem digitalen B2C-Umfeld mit komplexen Produkten und längeren Sales Cycles, oder im B2B-Marketing mit Markenelementen

  • Führungserfahrung mit Performance Marketing Managern, Agenturen und einer Creative-Funktion — intern, über Agentur oder über UGC-Produktion —, inklusive Agentursteuerung von der Auswahl über das Vergütungsmodell bis zur laufenden Leistungsbewertung

  • Nachgewiesene Tiefe in mindestens zwei Paid Channels (Google, Meta, LinkedIn): Du managst Kampagnenstrukturen nicht nur, sondern challengst und verbesserst sie fachlich, entscheidest datenbasiert, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale früh und kommunizierst Performance klar ins Team

  • Budgetverantwortung für Paid Media: Du weißt, wie man ein siebenstelliges Budget sinnvoll über Kanäle verteilt und datenbasiert optimiert, denkst in Kanal-P&L und Deckungsbeitrag und vertrittst Trade-offs gegenüber der Geschäftsleitung

  • Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von CRM- und Lifecycle-Programmen sowie Hands-on-Erfahrung mit CRM-Tools (insb. HubSpot), Landing-Page-Systemen (z.B. Webflow) und dem Tracking-Stack — serverseitiges Tracking, Conversion-APIs, Attribution und gängige Analytics-Plattformen: Du kannst die Kampagnen-Infrastruktur mitdenken und mitgestalten

  • Abstraktions- und Führungsstärke: Du kannst dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeiten, sie strukturieren und verantworten — auch über Performance Marketing hinaus

  • Erfahrung in cross-funktionaler Zusammenarbeit sowie in der Steuerung von Agenturen, Partnerschaften und externen Dienstleistern

  • Erfahrung mit Events oder weiteren Marketingdisziplinen ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Klare, überzeugende Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch

Mindset

Du bist ein Marketing-Handwerker mit Tiefgang: Du weißt, dass gutes Growth Marketing nicht nur auf Strategie basiert, sondern auf präziser Execution — du denkst konzeptuell und arbeitest hands-on in Kampagnen, wenn es drauf ankommt, und liebst beides. Du führst mit Überzeugung, aber ohne Ego, und freust dich über gute Ideen, egal woher sie kommen. Du baust kein Deck und wartest ab: Du willst sehen, was funktioniert, testest schnell, passt an und optimierst — und bringst die Erfahrung mit, um zwischen Lärm und echten Signalen zu unterscheiden.

Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

Das bieten wir dir

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 3.000€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 4 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ Why we are hiring ⭐️

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end: you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan.

About the Enterprise segment

  • Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

  • Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

  • Total Addressable Market: ~7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine.

More precisely, you will:

  • Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment.

  • Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

    • Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow‑up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

    • Be on the field with the team: prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers: Surface customer expectations, patterns, and blockers, and ensure they’re addressed through the right strategic and execution plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the F-G level range.

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐

You may be a great fit at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction, and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and advanced level in English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands‑on mentality: you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data‑driven and analytical: you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

  • Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR or Finance

.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

jobs.title: Brand Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Brand Marketing Lead to join our Brand & Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help own our brand marketing strategy and campaign execution across six European markets and be part of our marketing team as we scale our spend management platform. If you're excited about building category-defining campaigns that move Pleo from a good solution to the undisputed choice for mid-market finance leaders and are passionate about brand strategy and creative execution, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to the Director of Integrated Marketing, and work in close collaboration with the Director of Brand Experience and Strategy, as well as the Brand Intelligence Manager, our brand foundations team, PR, content marketing and digital channels team. You’ll partner cross-functionally with PMM, MOPS, CX and sales. This is a hands-on, IC role, where you'll do both the thinking and the work—strategy and execution both sit with you.

What you’ll be doing

As a Brand Marketing Lead, you will:

  • Own the brand marketing strategy that moves Pleo from ‘one of many’ to the undisputed choice for mid-market European finance leaders.

  • Build and execute integrated brand campaigns from concept through to reporting — learning from what we’ve just launched, and pushing further.

  • Create branded content that shows how financial services should be done. Content that recognizes the precision, rigor, and craft that finance leaders bring to their work.

  • Manage the funnel strategically — balancing awareness, consideration, and conversion. Not just fishing in the pond of people who already know us, but earning the right to speak to people we don’t know yet.

  • Own your budget and agency relationships — you’re the strategic partner they answer to.

  • Measure what matters — working with Brand Intelligence, Integrated Marketing, Data, and MOps to track brand lift, earned media, consideration, and how brand work flows into pipeline and revenue.

  • Set the benchmark for brand work in fintech — prove that category-defining campaigns come from strategic rigor and creative excellence working together. You’ll establish Pleo as the model for how brands should think about their audience, and show that understanding someone better than anyone else is a more powerful differentiator than any feature.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 10+ years in brand marketing (B2B or fintech might be helpful, but we care more about the thinking than the category)

  • A portfolio of work that shows you’ve led campaigns from strategy through to execution — ideally integrated campaigns that work across multiple channels

  • Strong stakeholder management skills — you can influence a room, sell an idea, and push back when something isn’t working

  • Strategic thinking + execution mindset — you’re equally comfortable building a 6-month brand strategy and getting your hands dirty on day-to-day campaign work

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace — this is a growing company, and things move fast. You thrive in that

  • Understanding of how brand and pipeline connect — you know that brand campaigns need to serve business growth, not just awareness

  • A point of view on category dynamics — you can look at a market and spot where everyone’s getting it wrong

  • A strong understanding for when/how to localise concepts, messaging & GTM campaigns across different markets.

  • Fluency in one or more of our European markets is a bonus (not required, but helpful)

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want to reframe an entire category's conversation by competing on human insight rather than just feature parity.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, autonomous environment where you can build campaigns that serve as a 5-year foundation.

  • You believe brand strategy must be grounded in audience understanding and directly drive business outcomes.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer purely high-level strategy without getting hands-on with day-to-day campaign execution.

  • You operate best in rigid, highly structured environments with slow moving pace and minimal ambiguity.

  • You view brand marketing in isolation from performance data, pipeline metrics, and commercial growth.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Map customer journeys across SMB, mid-market, and enterprise segments to identify brand opportunities.

  • Develop a comprehensive European brand roadmap that builds on recent launch momentum.

  • Develop a comprehensive European brand roadmap that builds on recent launch momentum.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Lifecycle Marketing Manager
Partner Account Manager, Intégrateurs de solutions de gestion
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Localisation et déplacements

Poste basé à Paris, selon la politique hybride de Pennylane, avec des déplacements réguliers en France auprès des partenaires, de leurs équipes et lors d’événements professionnels. Le portefeuille pourra inclure des partenaires franciliens et nationaux ; son allocation définitive sera précisée avec le manager.

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

  • Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

  • Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

  • Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

  • Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

  • Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

  • Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

Atouts appréciés

  • Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

  • Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

  • Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

  • Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

  • Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

  • Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

  • Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

  • A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

Process de recrutement :

  1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

  2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

  3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

  4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our International Customer Success team led by Philippe, Director of Customer Success. The team consists of around ten Consultants based across Barcelona and Paris, covering a global portfolio of B2B and B2C accounts. Together, you'll be ensuring each client's marketplace reaches its full performance potential — acting as the strategic backbone behind their growth.

Your Impact

  • Serve as the strategic and functional point of reference for B2B and B2C clients across both project and run phases — running tailored workshops with C-level stakeholders, shaping marketplace strategy, and keeping projects firmly on track to go-live.
  • Build personalised post-launch action plans with each client, lead data-driven business reviews, and translate KPI analysis into concrete growth recommendations for marketplace teams and senior leadership.
  • Define seller and customer strategies, benchmark against leading global marketplaces, and leverage the latest e-commerce trends and Mirakl product features to continuously drive client performance.
  • Work cross-functionally with Mirakl's Business and IT teams to anticipate risks early, align on priorities, and ensure clients extract maximum value from the platform.
  • Embed AI into your daily workflows — testing agents, providing structured feedback, and applying critical thinking to push the boundaries of how the team operates.

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 2 to 4 years' experience in at least one of the following: management consulting, a business role within an e-commerce company or online marketplace (B2B or B2C), or Customer Success in B2B Enterprise SaaS — marketplace or digital commerce experience is a strong plus
  • Proven track record of influencing and guiding senior stakeholders, including C-level, in a client-facing environment
  • Master's degree in Business, Management, Finance or a related field
Skills:
  • Analytical and data-driven thinking: comfortable building business cases, interpreting KPIs and turning data into actionable recommendations
  • Senior stakeholder management and influence
  • Strategic business advisory and structured problem-solving
  • Strong written, verbal and presentation communication
  • AI literacy with a critical mindset — you already use AI tools and are curious to go further

Languages

  • English: Full professional proficiency (required)
  • French: Full professional proficiency (required)
  • Spanish, Italian or Arabic (a real asset)

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Screening call with Talent Acquisition
  2. Interview with the Hiring Manager (business reviews and analytical skills)
  3. Values interviews with 3 team members

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. jobs.title: Senior Android Engineer

The Challenge  

More than 75% of Talk360's users are on Android. Every release you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of people across more than 190 countries - migrants calling home, travellers managing emergencies, families staying connected across borders. For these users, a dropped call or a crash isn't a UX inconvenience. It's a broken connection to someone who matters. 
 

The craft challenge here is real. Our users are often on older devices, limited data plans, and unreliable networks. Building an app that performs beautifully under those conditions requires engineering excellence, not shortcuts. We're entering a new phase of growth. Talk360 is profitable, our B2B2C platform is expanding, and mobile remains one of the most important products in the company. 
 

We’re looking for a Senior Android Engineer to join our mobile team. You’ll be a core contributor to app millions rely on, building features end-to-end, raising the bar on quality and performance, and working directly with Product and the business to understand our customers. You’ll work in a team where your impact is visible from day one, and where engineers who can reach across platforms are especially valued. 

 

What You'll Do  

Build and improve the Android app

  • Ship features and experiments on the journeys that matter most to our users, from onboarding to buying credit 

  • Help evolve our embedded calling SDK, used by partners to bring Talk360 calling into their own apps 

  • Shape our design system and help modernize the app as we move to a shared Kotlin Multiplatform codebase 

  • Own platform quality: releases, rollouts and app health 
     

Work across the mobile stack 

  • Contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform shared core, which powers Android, iOS, and our partner SDK 

  • Pick up iOS work where it makes sense (a strong plus, not a requirement) 

  • Work closely with the Mobile Lead on architecture and technical direction 
     

Learn from customers

  • Use AI tooling throughout your workflow to raise quality and speed; we’re building an AI-first engineering culture
