Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale.

Data Modeling & Visualization

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. That includes choosing the right aggregations, pre-computations and storage across Postgres and BigQuery, and turning them into visualizations that are clear, interactive and beautiful. Maps & Geospatial Data

Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful.

Roadmap Creation and Ideation

Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective.

Owning your scope

jobs.title: Marketing and Sales Support Officer
jobs.description:
Avion designs and builds full flight simulators that challenge the status quo in pilot training. As a Dutch OEM in a market dominated by large incumbents, we compete on innovation, agility and close customer relationships. Our simulators support airline training operations worldwide, including our flight training centres in Luton and Mumbai.

We are a compact team where your work is visible, your ideas land directly with decision makers, and no two weeks look the same.

Tasks

The role

As Marketing and Sales Support Officer, you own the full marketing function and support the commercial front line. The balance leans clearly towards marketing, roughly 80% marketing and 20% sales, with the sales side focused on first-line contact and business development rather than closing deals. You are part of the sales team and work closely with our training centres and partners across the industry. The sales side is deliberately a support function — you enable the sales team, you do not carry a quota.

This is a broad, hands-on role. One week you are launching a geo-targeted campaign around a trade show, the next you are hosting press at our Luton training centre or researching a new market segment. You get the freedom to shape how Avion presents itself to the world, and the responsibility that comes with it.

What you will do

Marketing and communications

  • Own and maintain the Avion websites, including content, SEO and campaign landing pages.
  • Plan and run digital marketing: Google Ads, LinkedIn campaigns and HubSpot, including automated workflows, email sequences and lead nurturing flows.
  • Grow and manage Avion's LinkedIn presence with content that resonates in the aviation training community.
  • Write and distribute press releases and maintain relationships with trade press worldwide.
  • Develop brochures, promo materials and campaign assets for global markets.
  • Plan and manage Avion's presence at 3 to 5 international exhibitions per year, including WATS, APATS and EATS, from booth design to post-show follow-up.

Sales support and business development

  • Handle first-line sales contact via email, phone and events, and qualify and route leads in HubSpot.
  • Support customer fly-outs at our Luton training centre.
  • Prepare market research and data analysis to support business development, and flag new segments or initiatives worth exploring.
  • Support the sales team with proposals, tender documentation and market intelligence.

Stakeholder and industry engagement

  • Maintain relationships with customers, partners, aviation authorities, trade associations and industry bodies.
  • Represent Avion at industry conferences and within professional networks.

Requirements

Who you are

We are not looking for an expert in everything. We are looking for a sharp generalist: someone who understands how the B2B marketing world works, learns new things quickly, and applies common sense to whatever lands on their desk.

You do not need to be able to shoot a commercial video yourself. But you should know what a good one takes, how long it takes, and what it should cost. When a vendor quotes you triple the fair price, you notice. When a new tool like AI can do in an hour what used to take a day, you are already using it. You judge, delegate and decide with confidence across a wide playing field, rather than going deep on one specialism.

  • 5+ years of experience in B2B marketing, ideally with a commercial or sales support component. Strong candidates with less experience and clear growth potential are also welcome to apply.
  • Experienced with HubSpot or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform.
  • Comfortable managing websites through a CMS.
  • Experienced with Adobe InDesign.
  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.
  • Willing to travel internationally, sometimes on short notice.

  • Curious about new tools and ways of working, and actively using AI to work smarter.
  • Able to brief, assess and manage external specialists such as designers, video makers and agencies, with a good sense of quality, timelines and fair pricing.

  • Dutch language skills.
  • Experience with Framer.
  • Experience with the wider Adobe Creative Cloud suite, such as Photoshop, Illustrator and Premiere Pro.
  • Affinity with aviation, aerospace or another technical B2B industry.
  • Experience with Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A rare breadth of ownership: strategy and execution, marketing and commercial work, in one role.
  • Direct access to leadership and short decision lines.
  • International exposure: global trade shows, customers on every continent, and training centres in the UK and India.

Interested?

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What you will do

  • You will be responsible for renewing and expanding our product through our customers, ensuring they get the maximum benefit from working with us

  • You will develop a comprehensive understanding of the typical business challenges faced by customers, aligning our features and business advantages to their needs

  • You will always be one step ahead, identifying risks for customers and proactively addressing them with a mitigation plan

  • You will strive for full utilization of customer orders, identify new opportunities, and collaborate with sales teams to drive growth and increase presence

  • Where appropriate, you will network between customers and departments, maintaining long-term relationships with stakeholders to advance the strategic direction of our development

Who you are

  • You have completed your studies in Business Administration or a comparable qualification and have relevant professional experience

  • You are familiar with B2B customer development - ideally in the customer success field - and tracking all customer needs

  • You are used to working in a fast-paced, international environment and can manage multiple projects and processes simultaneously

  • You have experience with (CRM/CSM) tools (e.g., Salesforce), (optional) accounting tools (e.g. DATEV), and (optional) logistics tools (e.g. TMS/TNT)

  • Optional: You have already gained experience in project management

  • In addition to fluent German, you also have fluent English skills, French skills are a plus

What we offer

  • A role to fulfill with entrepreneurial freedom and a pre-validated business model to push to the next level

  • An experienced founding team (three companies, 2 exits)

  • A future-proof job with an attractive salary as well as performance-related bonus payments in a successful and value-oriented company

  • Collaboration with top tier investors and angles (incl. various unicorn founders) as well as leading market experts

  • Beautiful office spaces, HQ in the centre of Berlin, multiple global locations 

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

Compensation: €50K – €55K

  • • Yearly On Target Earnings (Fixed + Bonus) €50K – €55K

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world, processing 25+ trillion data points annually across thousands of connected devices. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field.

As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve.

This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

  • Lead the ongoing strategy, operation, and continuous improvement of Samsara's vulnerability management program, along with other core application security programs — not just execute against an existing process, but define what the process should be.
  • Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten.
  • Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review.
  • Set technical and architectural direction for the program, translating leadership's strategic priorities into a concrete execution plan for the team.
  • Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly.
  • Mentor and level up other engineers on secure design and remediation practices, and be a technical voice other teams look to when priorities are unclear.
  • Communicate risk and remediation tradeoffs to engineering leadership in terms they can act on, without owning the relationship end to end.
  • Participate in security incident investigations involving high-profile vulnerabilities, assessing potential impact on Samsara's infrastructure.
  • Be regularly on call to support critical vulnerability response.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience as a cloud engineer or security engineer, including hands-on vulnerability management across a broad, multi-product enterprise environment  — not a single product or team's slice of it.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python, and JavaScript.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently set technical and architectural direction for a security program, and to drive remediation across a broad, multi-surface environment without direct authority over the teams doing the fixing.
  • Significant experience with modern vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Wiz, Semgrep) and deep familiarity with vulnerability scoring frameworks such as CVSS and EPSS.
  • Strong AWS cloud services background.
  • Deep understanding of Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
  • Hands-on use of AI/LLM tooling in your own security workflow — triage, detection logic, remediation drafting — plus credibility speaking to how AI is changing the threat landscape and the tooling available to address it.
  • Location: must be based in central or eastern timezones.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience with C/C++, relevant to firmware and embedded systems.
  • Background at a cloud-native, AI-forward company actively building agentic or AI-driven products.
  • Experience with security automation platforms (e.g., Tines) and serverless frameworks (e.g., AWS Lambda).
  • Experience integrating vulnerability management into modern CI/CD pipelines with a "shift-left" mentality.
  • Experience spanning SaaS, firmware, and corporate IT security programs — not just one product line.
  • Experience managing vulnerabilities within a FedRAMP-certified environment.
  • Experience building, extending, or wiring up AI copilots/agents for security workflows (e.g., automated triage, remediation drafting).

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

jobs.title: Design & Reliability Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Our mission

Shape the engineering foundations of Mistral AI’s next generation of compute capacity while improving the resilience of the infrastructure already in service. This role combines technical design leadership with field reliability engineering: you will establish demanding, practical requirements for colocation power and cooling, scrutinize proposed solutions and turn operating experience into better designs, safer changes and more reliable AI capacity.

Operating context & accountability

Mistral deploys high-density AI infrastructure in colocation facilities, where partners operate the underlying critical plant. You will be Mistral’s technical counterpart to providers, designers, commissioning specialists and internal IT and capacity teams. The position combines forward-looking design authority with hands-on technical investigation and portfolio reliability improvement. It requires depth in one core engineering discipline and the judgment to lead multidisciplinary decisions with specialist support.

Key responsibilities — design and technical standards

  • Own and continuously improve Mistral’s technical design criteria and colocation requirements for new facilities, expansions and retrofits, including availability objectives, failure domains, maintainability and operational flexibility.

  • Translate GPU platform roadmaps into measurable facility envelopes: IT load and transients, rack density, electrical topology, redundancy, cooling capacity, supply/return temperatures, flow, pressure, water quality and monitoring.

  • Review utility and MV/LV arrangements, transformers, generators, UPS, switchgear, busway, protection coordination, earthing, power quality and metering for suitability under demanding AI loads.

  • Review mechanical and controls architecture, including chilled-water and heat-rejection systems, pumps, control sequences, CDU integration, leak detection, filtration, water treatment and cooling recovery scenarios.

  • Lead multidisciplinary reviews of single-line diagrams, P&IDs, sequences of operation, design calculations, capacity models, failure-mode studies and proposed deviations; document risks and decisions.

  • Participate in site selection, technical due diligence, provider RFPs, design milestones and commercial technical schedules, challenging assumptions before they become delivery constraints.

  • Define design review and exception processes that balance performance, resilience, deployment speed, efficiency, capital cost and long-term operability.

Key responsibilities — commissioning and delivery assurance

  • Partner with delivery and commissioning teams to define functional and integrated testing requirements, acceptance criteria, evidence packages and outstanding-defect management.

  • Validate that electrical and cooling infrastructure can support the contracted AI load envelope under normal, maintenance and credible fault conditions.

  • Review test scripts and results for loss of utility, UPS/generator transitions, cooling component failures, controls faults, CDU interface events and staged restoration where applicable.

  • Ensure operational handover includes accurate drawings, asset and interface registers, monitoring points, setpoints, maintenance constraints, emergency procedures and unresolved risk ownership.

  • Support live-site changes and capacity upgrades with a disciplined review of impact, sequencing, rollback plans and operational readiness.

Key responsibilities — field reliability and root-cause analysis

  • Act as a technical escalation point for recurring or high-impact electrical, mechanical and controls incidents across operational colocation sites.

  • Analyze alarms, BMS/EPMS trends, event sequences, power-quality records, cooling telemetry, commissioning findings and maintenance evidence to distinguish symptoms from systemic causes.

  • Lead or challenge technical root-cause investigations with colocation partners, including common-mode failures, protection miscoordination, thermal instability, control logic, hydraulic performance and hidden capacity limitations.

  • Develop risk-ranked corrective actions and reliability improvement programs; validate effectiveness through evidence and post-change monitoring.

  • Identify fleet-wide patterns and feed lessons learned into reference designs, acceptance tests, technical specifications and provider governance.

  • Review maintenance and change proposals that create material exposure to compute availability, providing clear technical recommendations and escalation where required.

Key responsibilities — collaboration and leadership

  • Work with IT hardware, network and platform teams to understand the operational consequences of rack-level and cluster-level failure domains.

  • Influence colocation providers, consultants and OEM partners through technically rigorous, fact-based reviews without relying on direct operational authority.

  • Present design trade-offs, reliability risks and investment recommendations in language accessible to engineering leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Develop reusable standards, technical playbooks and engineering knowledge sharing to support consistent decisions across a rapidly expanding portfolio.

What success looks like

  • New capacity is accepted against well-defined electrical, thermal and resilience criteria with transparent technical exceptions.

  • Design risks are identified early, reducing late changes, stranded capacity and avoidable operational constraints.

  • Repeat incidents and unresolved critical engineering defects decrease as corrective actions are verified.

  • Field experience produces measurable improvements to future designs and live-site operating resilience.

Minimum qualifications

  • At least 8 years in mission-critical data center design, engineering, commissioning or technical reliability, including responsibility for complex technical decisions.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The mission of the Union Relations Lead

Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.


⭐ What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).

  • You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.

  • You'll shape the strategy, not just execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability (the playbook is yours to define)

  • You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.

  • Real ownership from day one, in one of the fastest-growing tech unicorns in Europe.

⭐️ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Represent Alan in federations, working groups, congrès and paritariste institutions where our sector’s future is discussed.

  • Be the credible consistent Alan voice social partners recognise

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Public Sector work

  • Be a partner to our teams serving large private employers and public sector clients, briefing them on the social partners context and how Alan’s offer speaks to their priorities

  • Introduce the right contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, turning Alan’s ecosystem relationships into concrete commercial leverage.

  • Share Alan’s content with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the dialogue at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.

  • Represent Alan in the federations and working groups where our sector's future is discussed, contributing a constructive and recognizable voice.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where social dialogue is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on social partner positions, branch agreements, and paritariste institutions shared with Enterprise and Public Sector deal teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our social partner engagement and documentation.

  • Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Public Sector team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

  • Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how social partners and competitors position themselves in our key markets.


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Union Relations Lead role at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of total experience in social partner relations: in a union organization, a branch federation, a paritariste institution, or in an external affairs role at a mutelle, IP or insurer

  • Have legitimate credibility at federation level: ability to engage federation leadership as a peer, built through a personal representative past or years of substantive engagement at federation level on employer side.

  • Have deep knowledge of the paritariste ecosystem: branch agreements, confederal mandates, protection sociale reforms, and how institutions at each level function

  • Have proven ability to build trust with social partners from the employer/state side

  • Have outstanding stakeholder management: calm, long-game, trustworthy, discreet, able to represent Alan substantively without making it about yourself.

  • Have ability to translate Alan’s product and strategy into compelling narratives for social partner audiences

  • Demonstrable impact from prior social-partner work on an organization’s commercial and strategic outcomes

  • Are a self-starter: comfortable building from scratch in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Are ego-free and lever-minded: you accelerate others, you don't seek the spotlight.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris.

Nice to have:

  • A confederal or federal elected / permanent past.

  • Experience inside a paritariste institution

  • Experience inside a sector federation on its social dialogue agenda.

  • Legal background in droit social and comfort reading accords collectifs quickly.

  • International exposure to the European social dialogue ecosystem.

  • Prior experience with RFPs or tenders involving union-negotiated or paritariste schemes.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

jobs.title: Head of Product Growth
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

 

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL runs product-led growth alongside our sales-led motion, with media translation as the strategic wedge. This role is responsible for turning DeepL into the default platform for translation worldwide driving adoption through product usage, and converting that usage into strong Product Qualified Leads (PQLs) tha convert into revenues and strengthen our sales pipeline. This role drives adoption of our core DeepL Translate features (e.g. Customization Hub, TQE) and cross-sell into adjacent products like DeepL Voice. You will start with a focus on Media Translation.

Your Mission: Put DeepL Translate in the hands of everyone, everywhere and use that reach to grow adoption across DeepL's broader product surface, turning usage into a reliable, high-quality source of PQLs for the business.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Use case strategy: prioritize the highest-value use cases for media translation, and and build the growth loops and product surface to drive adoption of them.

  • Distribution on the DeepL platform (main channel): drive media translation adoption directly within web, browser extension, and apps. Work closely with the API/MCP track.

  • PLG/PQL engine: define what qualifies as a strong PQL for media translation (usage signals, account characteristics, intent signals) , build the instrumentation to detect it, and design a clean handoff into sales.

  • Growth plays for feature/product discovery: design and run growth loops that help users discover and adopt more features and products beyond their initial media translation use case, expanding usage depth and breadth.

  • Cross-functional coordination:

    • Close collaboration with the Marketing team on funnel design, messaging, and PQL feedback loop.

    • Coordination with Sales/Sales Ops on PQL definition and handoff.

    • Iterate with Pricing & Packaging team on P&P strategy and optoimization

  • Metrics ownership: define and report on leading indicators (platform usage, feature adoption, cross-sell conversion, open-source adoption), and rigorously attribute product usage and these metrics to business outcomes (pipeline, revenue, retention) not just track activity, but prove and quantify its impact.

 

Qualities we look for

  • A builder, first and foremost someone who can build with AI, prototype fast, test with real users, and scale what works. This is a hands-on role, not a strategy-only one.

  • Track record building or scaling a PLG motion that feeds a sales organization ideally with direct experience owning PQL definition and handoff.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management this role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering, and needs to align each of them without owning their roadmaps.

  • Experience growing adoption within a core consumer/prosumer product (web, extension, or app), not just developer-facing surfaces.

  • Experience designing growth loops for feature/product discovery and expansion, not just top-of-funnel acquisition.

  • Experience with open-source community strategy has shipped or grown an OSS project, ideally in ML/AI.

  • Comfortable working in a hybrid PLG + SLG model and operating cross-functionally with teams whose roadmaps this role doesn't own.

 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JB1

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Data Engineer H/F - Paris
jobs.description:
Nos missions :

Nous intervenons chez nos clients sur des missions 100% data qui allient des dimensions techniques et stratégiques, où la donnée est le moteur de la performance opérationnelle. En tant que Data Engineer, vous êtes l'architecte qui rend la donnée exploitable. Selon votre profil, vous interviendrez sur la construction de plateformes data robustes (Data Lakehouse) ou sur l'industrialisation de flux complexes destinés à l'IA.

Nos clients (Luxe, Retail, Télécom, Banque...) font face à une explosion des volumes et des sources de données. Votre rôle sera de garantir la fluidité, la qualité et la sécurité de ces flux.


Quelques exemples de sujets du moment :

  • Migration d'un legacy on-premise vers une architecture Cloud Lakehouse (Snowflake/Databricks). #CloudMigration

  • Industrialisation de pipelines complexes sur GCP (BigQuery, Dataform) avec une forte culture de l'observabilité (Dynatrace) et du CI/CD. #Orchestration

  • Déploiement d'applications, d’API et de services IA (Algorithmes de prédictions ML, agents conversationnels, etc.) #MLOps

  • Audit et refonte de pipelines d’ingestion pour réduire les coûts de calcul et de stockage sur GCP ou AWS. #Performance

  • Développement de composants Kafka, exposition via API et garantie de la performance des flux temps réel à l'échelle internationale. #Streaming




L'humain :

Nous recherchons des talents :

  • Ayant un excellent relationnel pour faire le pont entre les besoins métiers et les contraintes IT,

  • Avec la volonté de bâtir des infrastructures scalables et robustes,

  • Dotés d’un esprit d’analyse rigoureux,

  • Qui accordent une importance capitale à la qualité du code (CI/CD, tests unitaires) et à la documentation technique (Confluence/Jira),

  • Curieux des nouvelles tendances (DataOps, IA générative appliquée au code),

  • Sensibles aux enjeux RSE pour intégrer des pratiques numériques durables,

  • Avec l’envie de transmettre et d’apprendre au sein d’une communauté technique active,

  • Maîtrisant l'anglais professionnel pour intervenir dans des contextes internationaux,

  • Disposant de quatre années d'expérience minimum sur des sujets d'ingénierie de données.

Les compétences techniques :

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation data à l’université ou en grande école et :

  • Maîtrisez parfaitement Python et SQL (analytique et procédural),

  • Avez une solide expérience sur un orchestrateur de workflow (Airflow, Prefect ou Dagster),

  • Connaissez les outils de transformation moderne comme dbt (Data Build Tool),

  • Maîtrisez au moins une solution Cloud (GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake) et ses services managés (BigQuery, Redshift, S3...),

  • Maîtrisez le cycle de vie logicielle (GitLab/GitHub, CI/CD, Terraform, Docker),

  • En bonus : vous avez déjà manipulé des flux de streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub), des frameworks d’IA générative (Langchain) ou des outils de Dataviz (Power BI).


Le processus de recrutement


  • Vous échangerez tout d’abord avec notre Talent acquisition Leader qui vous invitera à passer un premier entretien au téléphone, en visio ou sur site.

  • Un test technique (QCM et cas pratiques) vous sera envoyé par mail

  • Vous rencontrerez ensuite un consultant senior (manager ou practice leader) idéalement sur site.


Des échanges informels avec l’équipe pourront être organisés au besoin pour que vous puissiez en parallèle découvrir votre futur environnement de travail.

In 2025, Prima became part of the AXA Group, enabling us to further realize our potential through global expertise. Our core ambition remains market leadership through advanced technology, outstanding people, and an exceptional customer experience.

To help fuel that growth, we need a 

Claims Leader to play a pivotal role for Prima  as we build the UK most ambitious  next generation of tech-enabled Motor Insurance Claims operations.

 

Prima is in a crucial transition phase for Claims – as we move from an outsourced model (via a Third-Party Administrator) to an internalised model, built on proprietary tech and led by outstanding people in our Manchester city centre Claims Hub.

Reporting directly to the Head of Claims UK, you’ll take on two critical responsibilities:

  • Lead our specialist claims operations: Build and lead our Bodily Injury, Third-Party Property Damage, Credit Hire and Engineering  teams, taking ownership of their operational performance, claims outcomes and indemnity spend

  • Drive technical excellence across UK Claims: Establish and maintain technical standards across the entire Claims function, ensuring consistent approaches to reserving, liability assessment, claims handling, settlement strategies and quality assurance.

This is a rare opportunity to combine direct operational leadership with broader technical authority, shaping not only how we manage our most complex claims but also how our entire Claims organisation operates.We are looking for a visionary leader with an established track record of business-building. You will not just build a team; you will work to define our Technical & Complex Claims philosophy and approach, drive portfolio-level financial performance, and work closely with our Product and Engineering teams to translate your technical expertise into better processes and technology, challenging traditional approaches to claims management.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details


What you'll do

  • Lead our Bodily Injury, Third-Party Property Damage, Credit Hire, and Motor Engineering operations

  • Build and lead a capable team of high-calibre Technical Claims Specialists across High-Value Claims, Large Loss, Complex Bodily Injury, and Third-Party Property Damage / Credit Hire and Engineering. As we internalise and scale the overall functions, this role will lead a team of Managers responsible for each of these individuals domains of in-function expertise.

  • Establish strong processes across Technical Claims to ensure case strategies are effective, proactive, and focused on commercially-aware settlement.

  • Act as a senior point of escalation for Claims exceeding individual specialist handlers’ authority limits; ensure that key case decisions are effective, facts-based, and well-considered.

  • Review and challenge Complex Claims case strategies, detailed reserving calculations, litigation approaches, and high-value settlements.

  • Maintain excellent relationships with key Company stakeholders as well as stakeholders across our Capacity / Reinsurance Partners, in regard to the management of Complex Claims.

  • Drive technical excellence across UK Claims

  • Define and maintain the technical claims framework across all UK Claims teams, including FNOL, Engineering, Accidental Damage, Intervention, Bodily Injury, Third-Party Property Damage and Credit Hire.

  • Establish consistent technical standards covering liability assessment, reserving, settlement strategies, litigation management, fraud referrals and claims leakage.

  • Support the development of technical expertise across the entire Claims organisation through coaching, training, case reviews and knowledge sharing.

  • Work with the Head of Claims UK to identify systemic drivers of claims performance and implement improvements across the function.

  • Ensure technical standards evolve as our portfolio grows, incorporating emerging claims trends, regulatory developments and market best practices.

  • Hold joint accountability (with the Head of Claims UK) for financial performance of the UK Claims portfolio across all teams; 

  • Deliver Tech-enabling Domain Expertise: 

  • Serve as the lead Subject Matter Expert to Product and Engineering colleagues as we build a market-leading proprietary Claims Management Platform.

  • Support in translating expertise and experience / Technical Claims logic into easy-to-understand business requirements and user needs.

  • Work closely with our Claims Business Architect to design and embed well-structured and effective Technical Claims processes.

  • Collaborate closely with Data Science teams to develop and deploy predictive analytics and automated fraud detection models.


    • What we’re looking for

  • Senior Leadership: 10+ years of senior leadership experience within the UK Retail Motor Insurance market, either at a large UK insurer, MGA, or InsurTech.

  • Transformation Experience: Demonstrated experience of leading major claims transformation activity, with a proven track record of designing, scaling and/or restructuring Complex Claims functions.

  • Financial Acumen: Deep expertise in managing multi-million pound Complex Claims portfolios; proven ability to set reserving philosophies, establish appropriate authority limits, and manage the financial levers that drive Loss Ratio performance.

  • Subject Matter Expertise: Advanced knowledge of all areas of Complex Claims, including Large Loss, Complex Bodily Injury, Credit Hire indemnity strategy, Case Law, Litigation Management.

  • Entrepreneurial Approach: Demonstrably “can-do” mindset; able to effectively operate within a fast-paced MGA environment.

  • Tech-forward Mindset: Strong strategic grasp of how advanced technology (including AI, Machine Learning, and Advanced Data Science) can be used to disrupt and reinvent traditional claims handling processes for the better.

  • People Leadership / Gravitas: Proven ability to lead and inspire a team of ambitious Domain Managers, and Technical Claims Specialists.

  • Cross-functional Influence: Highly adept at working transversally across different functional areas to drive collaboration and ensure effective progress. 

  • Technology Ways of Working: Extensive experience of working with / alongside software engineers, product managers, and UX designers; knowledge of UK Claims Management platforms.

jobs.description:
About Moneybox
 
At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We're guided by our belief that wealth isn't about the money, it's about the means to more - more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind. Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping over one and a half million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they’re saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement.
 
Job Brief

We’re looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Manager, Paid Social to join the Paid Marketing team. In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping our growth trajectory over the coming years. Reporting into the Head of Paid Marketing, you will be responsible for leading our Paid Social strategy, identifying and driving forward new opportunities, and setting the strategic direction for some of our highest-spend acquisition channels.

You’ll work at the intersection of performance media, creative strategy, and cross-functional product marketing. You will own the roadmap for channels like Meta and TikTok across our entire product mix, be a key partner to our internal design team in our established creative testing loop, and additionally act as the dedicated performance marketing lead to help scale our Investing and Pensions products.


What You'll Do

  • Lead the channel strategy & growth: Own the roadmap for our Paid Social channels (including Meta and TikTok) across all product categories. You will autonomously manage a significant budget, driving user acquisition across both mobile app and web funnels, and implement structured trials to scale new channels (e.g. Reddit)

  • Balance strategy with execution: While this is a highly strategic role, we are a fast-moving business. You will need to be just as comfortable rolling up your sleeves, getting into the ad platforms, and executing hands-on when needed

  • Drive the creative testing loop: Partner closely with our internal design team, providing crucial data-driven input and collaboration to ensure we consistently identify winning creative concepts

  • Act as the cross-functional product lead: Alongside your channel-wide remit, you will gain broader experience within Moneybox by acting as the performance marketing lead for Investing and Pensions. You will embed yourself within the product squads to align marketing with commercial roadmaps and tackle strategic challenges to scale these products

  • Champion a commercial mindset: Drive a highly data-centric marketing approach with a strict emphasis on customer value, efficiency, and payback

  • Maintain an edge in the market: Hold expert-level knowledge across our product categories and competitors to strategically gain a competitive advantage in the social landscape

  • Share expertise & manage partners: Share marketing best practice, coach more junior team members, and source and manage third-party providers or platform reps where necessary


    • Who You Are

  • Someone with a genuine interest in Moneybox and the services we offer. Excited about being part of a fast-growing company that’s trying to make a positive mark on the world

  • A driven, ambitious individual who’s looking to accelerate their career in a scale-up business

  • A proactive self-starter who combines a bias for action with a willingness to learn, solve problems independently, and get your hands dirty when needed

  • A strategic thinker who is able to break down complex problems into actionable components

  • A collaborative team player who is able to take feedback on board

  • A great communicator who has a passion for their work and the people they work with


    • Experience & Skills

  • Minimum 7 years’ relevant performance marketing experience, with a deep specialism in Paid Social

  • Proven track record of managing large budgets and delivering results across core social channels (Meta, TikTok) and testing emerging platforms

  • Strong knowledge of marketing across both app and web

  • Strong experience partnering closely with design teams to drive and input into structured creative testing frameworks

  • Experience acting as a cross-functional lead or partnering closely with product teams to drive acquisition strategy

  • Data-driven and highly numerate, with a strong focus on CPA, customer value, and ROI optimisation

  • Strong organisational skills with meticulous attention to detail

  • Able to work autonomously as a strategic lead, while also collaborating effectively as part of a wider team
